we propose a phase precoding scheme to improve the performance of the compute-and-forward protocol and we show that the proposed scheme improves the degrees-of-frei-dom of the protocol.
we propose a new relaying protocol that increases the computation rate and the DoF of CoF protocol.

the design of new techniques to increase the DoF of wireless networks.
the design of phase precoders for the CoF protocol and their impact on the network DoF.
the use of phase-precoding in the CoF protocol.

phase precoding is a powerful tool for improving the performance of the CoF scheme in wireless networks.
we show how phase precoding can be used for the CoF protocol to improve the performance in terms of DoF and computation rates.

, in the presence of a large number of transmitters, the CoF protocol is not limited by the number of transceivers, as long as the phase precoding is applied.
